concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage (amendment-rejection path) vs plan.md:Constitution Amendment Routing
concerns.text: Plan Phase 8 promises a manifest 'of what was processed' that 'executes unconditionally' even if the constitution amendment is rejected (Phase-0-only run), but no task defines this rejection-path manifest artifact. T009 is defined only in terms of descriptors, PC scores, and exclusion flags from T003–T008, all of which are amendment-contingent; the dependency table simultaneously claims T009 'executes unconditionally' while ordering it 'after T004–T008'. An implementer in the rejection path has no task specifying what the manifest contains or how it is produced.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001/T006 vs constitution.md:Principle VII (N≥20) and SC-005
concerns.text: No task explicitly records the available subject count from the verified shard (e.g., in column_inventory.json or power_analysis.json's 'available N'). T006 consumes 'available N' for the SC-005 comparison and Constitution VII presupposes N≥20 musicians, but the task that establishes this number is unstated — it is only implicit in T006. Add an explicit available-N recording step to T001 or T006 so the power comparison is anchored to a produced artifact.
